data.function: re-rank report: rerank R4: series resistance on the PWM lines
data.ruling: The refutation stands. The datasheet figures the claim cites are correct. The conclusion "a round 2 resistor of 425 Ohm or more on the 16 PWM lines fits every ranked 244" is wrong. The claim checks the 8.7 V short only with the line clamped at 3.6 V. V75 has no owner answer ("for research", Research.md row V75). Its P2 found value, which the claim builds on, has two continuous faults. One is a short to the port's supply pin at up to 8.7 V. That found value also puts the clamp on the gate element's side of the resistor. A PWM line is driven low for most of each frame. With the line low, the clamp does not conduct and the 244 output sinks the whole fault current. On an SN74LV244A or 74LV244A at 425 Ohm, the worst-case output resistance from VOL 0.44 V at 8 mA is 55 Ohm, which gives 8.7 V / 480 Ohm = 18.1 mA. The verifier's (8.7 - 0.44) / 425 gives 19.4 mA. Either figure exceeds the 8 mA output current the claim uses to derive its own bound. With 4 or more of the 8 lines of one part shorted, the total exceeds the 70 mA VCC/GND rating: 145 to 155 mA for all 8. The claim applies an 8-line short itself in the ground case. On an SN74LVC244A at 142 Ohm, one line draws 52.8 to 58 mA, over the IO rating of +-50 mA. So "At 142 Ohm only the LVC244A pair qualifies" also fails on this fault. The claim's own method (recommended output current) gives a bound of (8.7 - 0.44) V / 8 mA = 1.03 kOhm for an 8 mA 244. Scope: function. The finding is about how the series resistance on the PWM lines is sized against V75's faults. It is not about the lifecycle, maker or LCSC identity of any part.
data.evidence: SCLS383R (SN74LV244A, revised August 2023), 6.1: IO +-35 mA at VO = 0 to VCC; continuous current through VCC or GND +-70 mA. 6.3: IOH -8 mA and IOL 8 mA at VCC 3 to 3.6 V. 6.5: VOL 0.44 V at IOL 8 mA, 3 V. 74LV244A Rev. 2 (4 July 2024), Table 4: IO +-35 mA, ICC 70 mA, IGND -70 mA. Table 5 states no IOH or IOL. Table 6: VOL 0.44 V at IO 8 mA, VCC 3.0 V. SCAS414AG (SN74LVC244A, revised June 2026), 5.1: IO +-50 mA; continuous current through VCC or GND +-100 mA. 5.3: VOL 0.55 V at IOL 24 mA, 3 V. Nexperia 74LVC_LVCH244A limiting values: IO +-50 mA, ICC 100 mA, IGND -100 mA. V75's found value (FU-A2/004-P2-R4.json): "Both faults, continuous: a short to ground, and a short to the port's supply pin at up to 8.7 V (F16) ... with the clamp and the bias network on the gate element's side". Arithmetic: 8.7 / (425 + 55) = 18.1 mA; (8.7 - 0.44) / 425 = 19.4 mA; 4 x 18.1 = 72.5 mA > 70 mA; 8 x 18.1 = 145 mA; 8.7 / (142 + 22.9) = 52.8 mA > 50 mA; (8.7 - 0.44) / 142 = 58.2 mA; (8.7 - 0.44) / 8 mA = 1.03 kOhm. The claim's other figures hold: 425 Ohm x 50 pF = 21 ns; 8 x 8 mA = 64 mA; (8.7 - 3.6) / 425 = 12.0 mA and 61 mW.
